messages:
nina_cs: FYI Crestline requested a split renewal: 65% prepaid now, 35% prorated midterm. They insist on KMS wording and need our vendor code on the PO. SOW needs a short appendix tweak. Can we support this?

trevor_bill: We can generate a pro forma for 65%. Need to confirm billing entity (US vs EU) and VAT handling. Also: will prepaid be applied as account credit or kept as prepayment balance?

cfo_mark: They'll instruct payment from EU AP (Crestline EU SARL). VAT exempt with valid VAT ID. Prepaid should be invoiced as prepaid invoice and applied against future usage. Vendor code is VC-CRST-2026.

leah_legal: I'll add KMS clause + our key-handling appendix reference and a one-sentence data residency note. Expect redline in 24-36h.

omar_onboard: Planning note: Crestline asked for 2x tech kickoffs and an architecture session after sign+funds. I'll tentatively block next-week slots.

nina_cs: @leah_legal pls include export-control blurb per EU playbook.

leah_legal: Added. Uploaded redline: https://files.example/crestline-sow-kms-redline.docx

docusign_bot: DocuSign envelope created by nina_cs  https://docusign.example/envelope/crestline2026  status: created

trevor_bill: Ops ask: can we stamp PO metadata: vendor_code=VC-CRST-2026, payment_flow=prepaid:65,prorate:35, billing_entity=EU? If yes I'll update PO template.

nina_cs: Yes, please. Also note risk: if legal redline slips beyond 48h or AP delays wire, onboarding shifts. Marking medium risk.

trevor_bill: I'll add a watch to billing tracker to flag unpaid pro formas after 3 business days.

omar_onboard: Provisional invites sent. Will confirm after signed + wire.

cfo_mark: We'll route signature promptly once redline looks good and wire same day as invoice.

nina_cs: Thanks all  will update when signed + funds clear. :thumbsup:
